title: Carrying Capacity Dashboard: releases, data layers and results (pre-freeze snapshot)
description: A static rebuild of the Carrying Capacity Dashboard (Lane, Dawes and Grace 2014, 2015; Lane 2017): versioned releases of the model with 2011 and 2025 data and published, corrected and improved methods, the data pipeline, the browser evaluator and the results files. This is a pre-freeze snapshot (version 1.0.0-prefreeze); the final version follows the method freeze.
